prompt: You already know that $23 \times 15 = 345$. Using that, what is $2.3 \times 1.5$?
hint: The digits stay the same — only the decimal point moves. Count the decimal places in the factors.

hints.text: The digits stay the same — only the decimal point moves. Count the decimal places in the factors.
$2.3$ has one decimal place and $1.5$ has one, so the product needs two.
Two places in $345$ gives $3.45$ — choose C.

explanation: The digits of the product come straight from $23 \times 15 = 345$.
Count the decimal places in the factors: $1$ in $2.3$ plus $1$ in $1.5$ equals $2$.
Place the point two spots from the right of $345$: $3.45$ (choice C).
It passes the common-sense test too: about $2$ times about $1.5$ should be around $3$ ✓

alternativeExplanations.title: Why the others are wrong
steps: $34.5$ uses only one decimal place, and $0.345$ uses three.
$345$ uses none at all, which would mean multiplying two numbers near $2$ and getting three hundred.
